mgmt_bio.text: Francois Jackow, born in 1969 and a French citizen, was appointed Chief Executive Officer of Air Liquide on June 1, 2022, succeeding Benoit Potier, who was retained as Chairman of the Board of Directors. He is a graduate of the Ecole normale superieure of Paris and holds a master's degree in chemistry from Harvard University and an MBA from the College des ingenieurs. He joined Air Liquide in 1993, led Air Liquide Japan from 2007 and became Group Vice President of the Large Industries business line in 2011; he joined the Executive Committee in 2014 as Group Vice President of Strategy, was involved in the 2016 Airgas acquisition, and in 2019 became Executive Vice President for Europe Industries, Europe Healthcare and Africa, Middle East and India.

sentences.text: At the May 5, 2026 Annual General Meeting, the Board confirmed it would maintain separate roles of Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, renewing Benoit Potier as Chairman and Francois Jackow as Chief Executive Officer, with both terms running to 2030.

sentences.quote: Since January 2026, he has been leading the Group Transformation and the Artificial Intelligence task force.
sentences.text: Within the Executive Committee, Matthieu Giard has led Group Transformation and the Artificial Intelligence task force since January 2026, alongside the Americas.

On October 5, 2026 management presented BEYOND, the 2030 strategic plan, with a 4 billion euro share buyback and a targeted 400 to 600 basis point operating margin improvement by 2030; Jackow said profitability allows capital allocation to evolve beyond core investments and acquisitions.

sentences.text: Under Francois Jackow, who took over as Chief Executive Officer on June 1, 2022, succeeding Benoit Potier in that role, execution against the ADVANCE plan has been ahead of schedule: the initial +160 basis point margin ambition was doubled to +320 bps mid-plan, and cumulative margin improvement reached +360 bps from 2022 to 2025.

sentences.quote: we significantly boosted our profitability, achieving our 2023 target of a recurring ROCE of more than 10% by the end of 2022
sentences.text: The recurring ROCE target of more than 10% was met as early as end-2022, a year early, with ROCE at 11.2% in 2025 despite dilution from accelerating investment.

Capital deployment was heavy: investment decisions totalled 16.9 billion euros over 2022-2025, above plan, plus the roughly 3 billion euro DIG Airgas acquisition, alongside a proposed dividend of 3.70 euros, up 12.1%.

sentences.text: Air Liquide completed its ADVANCE plan with comparable sales growth of +6.1% CAGR over 2022-2025 and recurring ROCE of 11.2% at end-2025, above the 10% target, with total investment decisions of 16.9 billion euros, above the 16 billion euro plan.

thesis_pillars.text: Air Liquide completed its ADVANCE plan with comparable sales growth of +6.1% CAGR over 2022-2025 and recurring ROCE of 11.2% at end-2025, above the 10% target, with total investment decisions of 16.9 billion euros, above the 16 billion euro plan. Management reaffirmed an ambition to lift the operating margin by +460 basis points cumulatively by end-2026. The roughly 3 billion euro acquisition of DIG Airgas adds a major South Korean player and strengthens semiconductor-linked opportunities. Decarbonization is a structural driver, as Group carbon intensity fell 46% versus 2015, beating the -30% target.
